body.p: Common Ground is the work of many hands. We are grateful to everyone who has shared their knowledge, time and collections with the project.

div.head: Acknowledgement of Country
div.p: We acknowledge the Wurundjeri Woi-wurrung people of the Kulin Nation, the Traditional Owners of the land on which Carlton and The University of Melbourne stand, and pay our respects to their Elders past and present.

list.item: The Melbourne History Workshop, School of Historical & Philosophical Studies, The University of Melbourne.
The University of Melbourne Civic and Community Impact Fund, which funded the project.

div.head: People
div.p: Thanks to the residents, students, volunteers and community members who have researched, transcribed, written and checked the entries on this site. A full list of contributors is coming soon.

list.item: State Library Victoria, for the digitised Sands & McDougall directories, the Melbourne and Metropolitan Board of Works detail plans and the historic survey plan used in the website banner.
Public Record Office Victoria, for historic plans georeferenced through the PROV Map Warper.
Map Warper, for georeferencing of the MMBW plans.
The National Library of Australia and Trove, for electoral rolls and newspapers.
University of Melbourne Spatial Data, for the property boundaries shown on the map.
OpenStreetMap contributors, for the modern base map.

div.head: Software
div.p: This site is built with Jekyll and hosted on GitHub Pages. The maps use Leaflet and three.js, entries are encoded following the guidelines of the Text Encoding Initiative, and the contribution form uses the Quill editor.
